Name: Auto Allergens
Author: literaltree
Description:
[size=3][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=2][color=#D4D4D8]Adds new allergen context tags to the game to be used by modders for uses such as gift tastes.[/color][/size]
[size=2][color=#D4D4D8]Currently implemented allergens:[/color][/size]
[size=2][color=#D4D4D8]- allergen_dairy[/color][/size]
[size=2][color=#D4D4D8]- allergen_seafood[/color][/size]
[size=2][color=#D4D4D8]- allergen_egg[/color][/size]
[size=2][color=#D4D4D8]I will be taking requests for more allergen info and more, specific, mod support, just give me a reasonable example and link specific mods, etc.[/color][/size]

[size=3][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[size=2][color=#D4D4D8]Install the latest version of SMAPI.[/color][/size]
[size=2][color=#D4D4D8]Unzip the contents into your mods folder[/color][/size]

[size=3][b]Source on Codeberg:[/b][/size]
